missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Вкус' is the masculine nominative as the subject. 'Странный' is the agreeing adjective, and 'у этого супа' shows whose taste it is.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Вкус' is the inanimate masculine accusative direct object of 'люблю', identical to the nominative. 'Острый' agrees with it.
Strategic focus: Genitive after нет. 'Вкуса' is the genitive form required by 'нет', here meaning he has no taste. 'У него' frames the possession.
Strategic focus: Dative object. 'Вкусу' is the dative form required by 'доверять', which governs the dative. 'Твоему' agrees in the masculine dative.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after отличаться. 'Вкусом' is the instrumental form required by 'отличаться', marking the distinguishing feature. 'Приятным' agrees in the instrumental.
Strategic focus: Prepositional after о. 'Вкусе' is the prepositional form required by 'о', meaning about the taste. 'Вина' is a genitive modifier naming the wine.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Вкусы' is the nominative plural as the subject. 'Яркие' agrees in the plural, and 'у этих специй' shows the source of the flavours.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Вкусы' is the nominative plural as the subject of 'сочетаются'. 'Эти' agrees in the plural, and 'хорошо' adds the manner.
Strategic focus: Genitive in a set phrase. 'Вкуса' is the genitive form in the fixed expression 'дело вкуса', meaning a matter of taste. 'Это' is the neuter subject.
Strategic focus: Instrumental in an idiom. 'Вкусом' is the instrumental form in the fixed phrase 'со вкусом', meaning tastefully. 'Одевается' is the reflexive verb.
